name: Champion's Battlegear
label: Quest
description: Champion's Battlegear: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, friend.
You'd be wise to hold on to them. As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's in our best interest to keep our most loyal allies well geared, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great work, friend. Please accept this on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. You've certainly earned it, friend!
